name: Ghost Walker Albert

intro.text: Hester sees visitors who can find the crypt door. I see them first. Good evening. Mind your head, and your footing, and the Roman soldier.

win: Oh well done. Go on in. She's a stickler, but a fair one.
after: Hester's family have kept this place for a very long time. The ghosts say she's the best caretaker they've ever had. Mostly because she lets them stay up.
